title: ActivityClassification
summary: A research codebase for physical-activity classification and eCoaching recommendation modeling using sensor datasets such as MOX2-5 and PMData. Its MOX_Data_Aug.ipynb notebook directly instantiates and fits a standalone CTGANSynthesizer (ctgan package) and imports copulas.multivariate.GaussianMultivariate to augment sensor data, while also importing SDV's sdv.tabular.CTGAN without ever calling it.
needs: sdv.tabular.CTGAN import (line 322) appears unused elsewhere in evidence; GaussianMultivariate import shown but no explicit fit/sample call captured.
